metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-83549: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.. Product: SMA1000 Appliances
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-83549" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-83549" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-83549" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-016
